rawFindings.title: --save-exact now writes the source path for renamed packages, breaking normal registry installs
rawFindings.explanation: For a package installed from a registry endpoint with a declared name different from the source string, this branch now saves `<source>#<version>` instead of the version when `--save-exact` is used. The resulting `bower.json` entry is not a valid semver pin for registry packages and changes the dependency type from a version to a path-like endpoint.
rawFindings.suggestion: Only append `source#` for explicit local/git/file endpoints; keep registry installs saved as the exact version string.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Installing `jquery-ui` with `bower install jquery-ui --save --save-exact` writes `dependencies.jquery-ui = 'jquery-ui#1.12.1'` instead of `'1.12.1'`, so a subsequent install/update no longer treats it as an exact version pin.
